individual_run_test_results.prompt: How do I toggle Do Not Disturb mode using a keyboard shortcut?
individual_run_test_results.agent_output:
The method to toggle Do Not Disturb mode using a keyboard shortcut depends on your operating system:

- On macOS, you can usually toggle Do Not Disturb by holding the Option key and clicking the Notification Center icon in the menu bar, or by setting a custom keyboard shortcut in System Preferences > Keyboard > Shortcuts > Mission Control.

- On Windows 10/11, you can toggle Focus Assist (similar to Do Not Disturb) by pressing Windows key + A to open the Action Center, then clicking the Focus Assist button. You can also set up custom shortcuts with third-party tools.

- On some Linux desktop environments, there may be specific shortcuts or you can configure your own.

If you tell me your operating system, I can provide more specific instructions or help you set up a shortcut.
